registry_policy.encoding_source: First-party KIE.ai research dated 2026-08-26 (docs.kie.ai market pages + kie.ai playground pages, curl-verified). Every numeric limit is traceable to a quoted vendor value. NOT_EXPOSED/NOT_PUBLISHED is stored as null, never invented.

cap_status_legend.VERIFIED: quoted from a vendor page verbatim; hard cap, hard-fail
cap_status_legend.OWNER_OBSERVED: owner-observed live behavior; no vendor figure; warn-only, never hard-fail
cap_status_legend.OWNER_CONFIRMED: operator-confirmed live behavior; vendor docs page disagrees; warn-only, never hard-fail
cap_status_legend.NOT_PUBLISHED: vendor publishes no cap; stored as null; no invented value
cap_status_legend.LIVE_PROBE_REQUIRED: cap undetermined; probe before long prompts; no invented value

known_inconsistencies: RESOLVED by operator confirmation 2026-08-27: prompt cap is 25,000 characters (owner-confirmed, authoritative). Docs page text (2026-08-26, verbatim): "maximum 20,000 characters", that figure is STALE. Quoted verbatim for provenance. cap_status OWNER_CONFIRMED; owner_observed_cap_chars 25000; vendor_hard_cap_chars stays null (vendor never published 25k). Warn-only, never hard-fail.
Quality tier is expressed as resolution enum (1K/2K/4K); no separate quality field.
models.notes: Owner's preferred general KIE image route when compatible. High-fidelity general generation, editing, product/brand images, detailed long-form creative instructions. Per-resolution exclusion (page verbatim): "for 2K and 4K resolution, the following aspect ratios are not supported: 5:4, 4:5, 3:1, 1:3, and 9:21"; "Images with the aspect ratio set to auto or without a specified aspect ratio parameter will only be converted to 1K images"; "Images with a 1:1 aspect ratio cannot be converted to 4K images". House band 5,000-19,000 is legal; hard-enforcement status PENDING_ACCEPTANCE_TEST, validators warn only.

known_inconsistencies: Marketing page https://kie.ai/qwen-image-3 (2026-08-26, verbatim): "Qwen Image 3.0 API supports up to 4.5K token inputs", TOKENS. Docs schema says prompt maxLength 5000 CHARS. Unreconciled; likely same limit described differently. Per spec rule D: token cap, NOT a char cap, do not convert; token-aware validation only. Docs char figure (5000 maxLength) is the only documented numeric and is NOT stored as a cap per rule D.
nsfw_checker default: docs pages say default false; playground says "Defaults to true in the Playground". Playground default vs API default differ; UNDETERMINED.
image_size enum here is named image_size (not aspect_ratio), 8 values, no auto, default 16:9.
models.notes: Structured layouts, multilingual content, typography, info-dense documents/UI visuals. Chinese and English supported. docs example: prompt_extend true, nsfw_checker false, seed 1.
